outcome: Effectiveness of BBT for postpartum haemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: 128 patients treated with BBT for severe PPH due to placenta previa and PAS at Bursa Yüksek Ihtisas Education and Research Hospital, Bursa, Turkey, from June 2016 to June 2019
finding: Bakri balloon tamponade (BBT) was found to be an effective tool for managing postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) in patients with placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum, with a success rate of 91.3%.
mod_finding: BBT was successful in both vaginal and cesarean deliveries, including those with multiple repeat cesarean deliveries.
